notes: לָכֵן is segmented into preposition and adverb but rendered by the single word 'Therefore', so the two share one unit headed on the lexeme-bearing morpheme (rule 30).
The waw of וְנָתַתִּיו takes the 'even' the ASV writes inside the verb phrase (rule 14's open list, rule 25); the unit's note names the alternative of marking it unrepresented and 'even' added.
'his own' belongs whole to the suffix under rule 18's emphatic-possessive clause.
